messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to"
set: ["take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to", "take exactly as your doctor tells you to", "take dose in the morning", "take only if doctor tells you to", "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to", "take with a meal unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "only take potassium-rich foods if doctor tells you to", "do this unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "if you miss your bedtime dose, take your next dose at the regular time the following evening", "take in either the morning or the evening", "talk to your doctor if you develop symptoms", "take in the morning or at night", "start another 14-day course within 4 months only if your doctor tells you to", "do not use more than one dose in a 24-hour period unless your doctor tells you to", "take your next dose at the regular time", "your doctor may occasionally change your dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
